title: Checklist component data
description: Checklist. Each item is its own top-level key item_<id>; the value is $defs/item without the id, and '' deletes the item (tombstone). New item ids are uuidv7. 'items' is the deprecated legacy whole list: read-only, never written. The app reads it first (each entry's order defaults to its list index), then an item_<id> key with the same id REPLACES that legacy entry entirely, and item_<id> = '' removes it. To change a legacy item, write a full item_<id> value including order.

items.description: Deprecated legacy whole list. Read-only, never written. An item_<id> key with the same id replaces the legacy entry.

allowToggleInUsage.description: Run-mode gate for checking items. Default true.

allowAddInUsage.description: Run-mode gate for creating, deleting and editing items. Default true.

maxVisibleItems.description: Maximum number of items shown. 0 means unlimited. Example: 5.

templates.description: Saved templates: a template name maps to a list of item titles. Example: {"Weekly": ["Milk", "Bread"]}.

defaultSort.description: Default sort order: manual, date or priority. null means not set.

defaultGroup.description: Default grouping: none, date or priority. null means not set.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^item_.+$.description: One checklist item per key, item_<id>. The value is an object per $defs/item without id. '' deletes the item (tombstone). New ids are uuidv7. Example: item_0198a0f2-... = {"title":"Buy milk","checked":false}. Members may write this key only when allowAddInUsage is not false (an absent flag uses its default); owner and admin always may. For changes to checked the flag is allowToggleInUsage; detailsDocument and order are open to every member.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

v.description: Entry format version. Always 2 in a v2 entry.

id.description: Item id. Not written in item_<id> values, the key carries it; present only in legacy items.

title.description: Item text, up to 1000 characters. Example: "Buy milk".

checked.description: true when the item is done.

detailsDocument.description: Notes for the item as Quill delta ops, or null for none. Example: [{"insert":"Semi-skimmed\n"}].

assigneePublicKey.description: Public key of the member the item is assigned to, or null.

attachmentIds.description: Ids of uploaded files attached to the item. Agents cannot upload files.

priority.description: Priority: none, low, medium or high.

date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD in local time, or null. Example: "2026-12-24".

time.description: Due time, HH:MM in local time, or null. Only meaningful together with date. Example: "18:30".

order.description: Sort position as a number, lower sorts first. Default 0.
